existing_defect.same_process_cache: stores completion_text then re-renders Responses payload, regenerating response/item/call UUIDs
existing_defect.restart: persistent segment progress can survive while rendered Responses result does not
existing_defect.ordering: current server persists turn affinity and conversation segment before responses_payload() renders the client-visible tool call

required_design.atomic_unit: one durable record containing request fingerprint + segment progress + already-rendered Responses result
required_design.identity: request key remains content-free fingerprint; do not persist owner prompt or secrets as identity material
required_design.replay: exact retry returns stored rendered payload with identical response_id/item_id/call_id and no provider inference
required_design.streaming: SSE is regenerated only from the stored rendered payload; IDs remain identical
required_design.safety_floor: legacy/corrupt state that proves progress but lacks matching replay must fail closed, never re-plan

offline_crash_matrix.after_provider_before_atomic_publish: PROVIDER_ALLOWED because no durable progress was published

implementation_note: Do not bolt a second replay file beside conversation_segments.json: two independent atomic renames still permit crash states where segment progress exists without replay. The replay and segment progress for the completed turn must share one atomic publication boundary, or use an equivalent journal/transaction with recovery proof.
windows: No native Windows semantics claimed. This is a platform-neutral lifecycle/crash invariant model only.
